comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Is Caracas at Central Capital status (culture, trade and maritime at 40k or higher points)? You can check at the City Official by clicking the 'offer discovery' button, or at the Shopkeeper by using the 'offer item' button, but only if you're Venetian. Otherwise, try the archives at another port like Willemstad, Grand Cayman, and so on - you can get archive maps from any New World port, regardless of nationality.
